title: How close did Ino get? Japan's first measured map against a modern one
excerpt: A retired sake brewer measured Japan on foot. I laid 28 sheets of his 1821 map on today's coast: a typical sheet's coast sits a median 280 m from the modern line.
seo_description: Ino Tadataka's 1821 survey map of Japan beside a modern map: 28 sheets, 1,494 km of coast, a median 280 m from today's.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Ino's Japan' in black and red on pale paper, beside a modern map of Hokkaido with the coast drawn on Ino's sheets traced in red along the real shoreline. Text: 28 sheets of the 1821 survey map, 1,494 km of drawn coast, a median 280 m from today's.
